title: Fleet Governance v1 — EVIDENCE RECEIPT
description: Executor-produced truthful report + observed execution facts. Each claim carries an epistemology status (PROVEN/PROPOSED/ASSUMED/FAILED/INDETERMINATE). The actual Switchyard-selected inference resource is an OBSERVED receipt fact, never a BWP input.

actual_executor.description: Observed. Must match declared for a clean PASS; mismatch is a material finding.

actions_taken.description: Semantic action ids actually taken. Must be a subset of the REQUEST's allowed_actions (authority compliance).

resource_observed.description: OBSERVED FACT ONLY. Where routing telemetry/journal/exporter evidence exists, records the actual resource/model/provider that executed, plus the OBSERVED inference-resource locality (local|hosted|unknown). null when not observable. Provider/model names NEVER establish locality.

locality.description: OBSERVED inference-resource locality from authoritative routing/resource telemetry (e.g. Switchyard routing.jsonl / exporter / readiness source). local = on-prem/local execution surface; hosted = external cloud resource; unknown = not observable from available telemetry. Provider/model names alone never establish locality.

note.const: Observed from routing telemetry/journal/logs. Never an input to the BWP; never inferred when unobservable.

satisfies.description: Semantic evidence types from the REQUEST's evidence.requirements that this claim satisfies (read_back, hash, disk_state, routing_telemetry, ...).

criterion_refs.description: References (index or id) to REQUEST acceptance.criteria that this claim positively adjudicates. A criterion is MET only when a PROVEN claim references it; absence of a FAILED claim alone never makes a criterion MET.

acceptance_self_assessment.description: Executor's own claim about acceptance. NEVER authoritative; Turnstone adjudicates from evidence.
